data.name: Fawazul
data.gender_notes: Fawazul is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'f-w-z' which signifies success and victory. The name Fawazul carries the meaning “Successful, Victorious” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fawazul usually hope their child will grow to embody successful, victorious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Fawazul is often associated with the concept of victory over adversity, reflecting the belief that through faith and perseverance, one can overcome life's challenges.
data.etymology: Fawazul belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Successful, Victorious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fawazul total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
